summary: Improve mobile benefit-payment operations with practical journey mapping, exception analysis, and provider oversight. Explore the five-day course.
lede: Mobile e-payments for social assistance use digital channels to deliver benefits and give recipients access to funds. For payment officers, programme managers and digital delivery specialists, training connects payment instructions, provider records and recipient access through phones, wallets and agents. You will map payment journeys, analyze exceptions, and develop reconciliation, service-recovery and agent-readiness tools for benefit delivery.
audienceIntro: This intermediate course suits professionals who manage or support mobile payment delivery for social assistance and need to connect programme rules with provider operations and recipient access.
prerequisites: Working familiarity with social assistance delivery, payment operations, or programme finance. Coding is not required. Intermediate Excel use is helpful for the case exercises.
topics: Digital financial services, payments & fintech risk
